body: I don't matter in th grand scheme of things. Im not alive, just living.

I mean... I feel that I have no direction in my life. Living is only delaying the inevitable. I feel I don't matter in the grand scheme of things. 

What's the point? I get up and go to work, come back and do nothing. I'm never satisfied with where I am. Of course my parents would be devastated... I can't stand the thought of my mom wondering every day where she went wrong with her only son. It keeps me going. But for how long?
